sources.observed_operation: Opened RFC and located If-Match and 412 sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Origin server evaluates If-Match before a state-changing method; false condition means method not performed, with 412 response permitted; RFC allows an already-succeeded exception described in §13.1.1.
sources.applicability: Possible version-conditional save for concurrent reviewers; requires API enforcement and does not specify UI conflict resolution.

critic_recheck.observed_operation: Reopened RFC; checked strong If-Match comparison, failed-precondition behavior, and already-succeeded exception.
critic_recheck.governing_condition_default_exception: If-Match commonly prevents lost updates; a false condition normally prevents method application and may return 412, but origin server may return success if it can determine the same state-changing request already succeeded.
critic_recheck.applicability: Supports conditional writes if the API implements validators; does not define conflict UI or idempotency behavior.

reviser_recheck.observed_operation: Opened RFC 9110; checked §§13.1.1/13.2 for strong If-Match, precondition ordering, 412, and already-succeeded exception.
